label: Bible Study
prompt: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my _____.
verse: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
note: The Last Supper, eaten at Passover — bread taken, blessed, broken, and given.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Then shall the lame man _____ as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.
verse: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.
note: The lame shall leap like a deer and the dumb shall sing — streams breaking out in the desert.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Also he sent forth a _____ from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;
verse: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;
note: Noah's first scout was a raven that never reported back; the dove was the second try, and the one we remember.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a _____ of blue:
verse: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:
note: Fringes with a blue cord reminded Israel of God's commands — the woman in Matthew 9 touched Jesus' hem.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he shall be unto thee a _____ of thy life, and a nourisher of thine old age: for thy daughter in law, which loveth thee, which is better to thee than seven sons, hath born him.
verse: And he shall be unto thee a restorer of thy life, and a nourisher of thine old age: for thy daughter in law, which loveth thee, which is better to thee than seven sons, hath born him.
note: The women of Bethlehem to once-bitter Naomi about her new grandson: 'a restorer of thy life' — and Ruth better than seven sons.
